basics.name: Tanishq Joshi
basics.label: Software Engineer — Backend & AI Systems
basics.summary: Backend-focused Software Engineer with 7.5+ years building production APIs, AWS serverless systems, and AI-powered products. Ships end-to-end: designed, built, and launched two live products solo (kaarters.com, createfreeresume.com). Deep in Node.js, TypeScript, and AWS (Lambda, S3, SQS, Step Functions), with hands-on LLM work — RAG pipelines, OpenAI API integrations, and prompt engineering. Looking for product engineering roles at early-stage startups where I own features from schema to ship.

projects.name: Kaarters
projects.description: Live B2B platform for FMCG distributors to manage retailers, delivery riders, routes, and order fulfillment.
highlights: Built the full stack solo: Next.js 16 / React 19 / TypeScript frontend (Vercel), Express + Prisma/PostgreSQL backend (Render), with GitHub Actions CI/CD for automated build-and-deploy on every push.
Designed the relational data model end-to-end — distributors, riders, retailers, routes/stops, and an order lifecycle with status transitions, payment-collection tracking, and audit notes.
Implemented role-based JWT authentication (distributor/rider roles), rider assignment, batch order-status updates, paginated list APIs, and CSV export for orders, retailers, and distributors.
Integrated WhatsApp messaging for order notifications and built drag-and-drop route/stop sequencing for delivery planning.

projects.name: CreateFreeResume
projects.description: Free, privacy-first ATS resume builder — fully client-side, so resume data never leaves the browser.
highlights: Built resume import that parses existing PDF and DOCX resumes (pdf.js, mammoth) into structured, editable sections.
Implemented live preview with in-browser PDF generation (@react-pdf/renderer), multiple ATS-safe templates, and Markdown export.
Shipped as a production Next.js app on Vercel with GitHub Actions CI/CD for automated deploys, Zustand state management, SEO (sitemaps, Open Graph images), and zero backend cost.

projects.name: RAG Document Q&A Service
projects.description: FastAPI microservice for question-answering over private documents with source citations.
highlights: Built the full RAG pipeline: PDF/text/Markdown ingestion with overlap-aware chunking, sentence-transformers embeddings, and ChromaDB vector storage with idempotent upserts.
Implemented top-k semantic retrieval feeding Claude (Anthropic API) for grounded answers, returning cited source chunks alongside each response.
Designed as a clean, configurable service (Pydantic settings, REST endpoints for ingest/query/health) — swappable embedding and chat models.
Led a team of 5+ engineers across 3 parallel workstreams, maintaining 100% on-time delivery over 4 consecutive quarters.
Architected and maintained serverless API contracts across 10+ AWS accounts (Lambda, S3, SQS, Step Functions, CloudWatch), supporting multi-cell production deployments.
Built Python and Node.js automation for code-migration pipelines, cutting manual migration effort ~60% and reducing error rates to near zero.
Implemented AI-assisted automation using GitHub Copilot and prompt engineering to auto-remediate security vulnerabilities and generate unit tests, reducing QA turnaround 40%.
Applied TDD (Jest/Mocha) and Agile practices across all delivery cycles, maintaining 85%+ test coverage on critical API paths.
Secured APIs handling 200K+ daily requests with JWT authentication and rate limiting, eliminating unauthorized-access incidents in production.
Integrated AWS SQS, SES, Step Functions, Lambda, and S3 into production systems, improving cloud service efficiency ~30% and reducing infrastructure costs.
Containerized deployments with Docker, cutting deployment time 40% and ensuring dev/prod environment parity.
Designed and shipped 15+ REST API endpoints across healthcare and SaaS products serving 10,000+ end users on web and mobile.
Turned Figma designs into responsive React/Next.js frontends, increasing site traffic 25% and cutting average page load time 20%.
Built CMS modules and REST APIs with Node.js/Express for 3+ content-heavy web platforms, owning features from schema design through deployment and post-release support.
Designed relational schemas and built Node.js/Express backends for 5+ client applications, reducing average API response time 25% via query optimization.
Developed UI components and integrated REST APIs for internal web applications; delivered 3 complete projects.
